elements.name: s6-body
elements.text: A plan is only feasible when every resource handoff survives both operational and environmental constraints.

elements.name: s6-quant-note
elements.text: Capacity is distributed across the chain. A fast CTS cannot recover a missed tide; a ready tug cannot compensate for a wrong grade sequence.

elements.name: s6-bottom-note
elements.text: The planner’s job is not “where is the vessel?” but “which next move keeps the whole chain feasible?”
